operations.description: Read the mutex handle from this[60] (offset 0xF0); if non-null, call WaitForSingleObject(handle, timeout from this[61] at offset 0xF4).
Treat the lock as acquired only when the handle is non-null and WaitForSingleObject returned 0 (WAIT_OBJECT_0) or 128 (WAIT_ABANDONED); otherwise the read pointer is null.
Read the protected integer from this[59] (offset 0xEC).
If the mutex handle is non-null, call ReleaseMutex(handle).
